items.title: SELUTION DeNovo subanalysis hints at benefit for balloon-based strategy in high bleeding risk patients
items.summary: Results of a subanalysis of the SELUTION DeNovo trial point towards a potential clinical benefit of a drug-eluting balloon (DEB)-based percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) strategy in patients at high bleeding risk.

items.title: iPerf concludes clinical trial of novel dual-lumen femoral arterial cannula for cardiopulmonary support
items.summary: iPerf has announced the conclusion of its first clinical trial evaluating its dual-lumen femoral arterial cannula for cardiopulmonary support.

items.title: Meta-analysis highlights uncertainties over clinical benefit of LAAC compared to oral anticoagulation

items.title: Corcym expands mitral repair platform with first-on-human use of Memo 4D Curve annuloplasty system
items.summary: Corcym has announced the first-in-human implant of Memo 4D Curve, a semi-rigid open-configuration annuloplasty ring for mitral valve repair. The procedure, a robotic cardiac surgery, was performed by Michael Ibrahim at UVA Health University Medical Center (Charlottesville, USA).
